Struct MarginPadding

Namespace: osu.Framework.Graphics
Assembly: osu.Framework.dll

Holds data about the margin or padding of a osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable. The margin describes the size of an empty area around its osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable, while the padding describes the size of an empty area inside its container.

TotalHorizontal

Gets the total absolute size of the empty space horizontally around the osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable if used as margin, or the absolute size of the space left empty from the right and left of the container if used as padding. Effectively osu.Framework.Graphics.MarginPadding.Right + osu.Framework.Graphics.MarginPadding.Left.

TotalVertical
